deepdive.thesis: Kalyani Cast-Tech Limited is investing in expansion projects with a planned capital expenditure of Rs. 70 Cr, aiming to enhance its production capabilities and drive growth. The company is focused on avoiding ambiguity and ensuring accurate understanding among investors and stakeholders. With a strong foundation in industrial manufacturing, Kalyani Cast-Tech Limited is poised for future expansion.
